basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old sports enthusiast from Columbus, Ohio. I work as a freelance graphic designer and spend most of my free time playing Madden Ultimate Team and exploring different strategies to improve my gameplay. I love exploring new places, which led me to visit Kyoto last year—an unforgettable experience. I have a keen interest in automotive discussions, especially about Kia Soul, as that's the car I drive. I'm single and usually online in the evenings after 7 PM EST, diving into gaming discussions or checking out art-related subreddits.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Visual Arts, which has enhanced my skills in design and creativity. My interest in sports games dates back to my teenage years, and I've learned advanced gaming strategies through online forums and YouTube tutorials. I also keep myself updated with the latest Madden updates and community insights.
